synthesis.executive_summary: 今日论文聚焦于提升文档解析效率、处理低资源语言与结构验证，并探索生成式AI在信息抽取中的应用。PaDoc通过并行解码显著加速端到端文档解析，DTRNet创新性地将字根结构验证融入手写识别，而MameLoshnLM和Mapping Armenian Paris则展示了针对低资源语言文档处理的可行方案。此外，模式引导的生成式抽取框架为结构化信息提取提供了高效新思路。总体而言，研究趋势正从通用端到端模型向高效、可解释、面向特定场景的精细化方案发展。
synthesis.trend_summary: 1. 效率优化成为焦点：PaDoc通过并行解码和布局分支显著提升端到端解析速度，反映对生产环境高吞吐量、低延迟的需求；2. 低资源语言和历史文档处理受到关注：Mapping Armenian Paris和MameLoshnLM等研究专门解决资源匮乏语言的OCR和NLP问题，弥补现有模型覆盖不足；3. 可解释性与结构信息增强：DTRNet利用字根结构实现伪造字符检测，Schema-Guided框架强调语义评估，均在追求更可靠、可验证的OCR输出；4. 生成式AI应用深化：从文本识别到信息抽取，生成式模型在文档理解中扮演更核心角色，如零样本抽取和语义比较评估。
common_innovations: 利用并行解码和分支结构减少序列解码深度，提升文档解析效率
结合结构先验（如字根、布局、模式）增强模型输出的一致性和可解释性
针对低资源语言，采用VLM或持续预训练结合数据引导策略构建定制化模型
在评估环节引入语义对齐和生成式比较，而非仅使用传统F1或编辑距离
future_directions: 探索将PaDoc的布局分支思想扩展到表格或公式等密集结构，处理更复杂的层级依赖
设计自适应并行调度策略，根据页面复杂度动态调整并发分支数，进一步优化硬件利用率
将DTRNet的伪造字符检测扩展到开放集场景，支持动态扩展字形结构数据库
利用MameLoshnLM的语料构建方法，为其他低资源语言（如手写变体或方言）建立专用OCR预训练资源
开发可迁移的VLM提示工程模板，结合人工反馈闭环，提高低资源历史文档OCR的准确性
将模式引导的抽取与OCR系统集成，实现从扫描图像到结构化数据库的端到端自动化流程
engineering_takeaways: 采用vLLM后端和前缀缓存复用可显著提升端到端解析的并发处理能力和吞吐量
在低资源语言OCR中，可利用VLM作为数据引导，结合Label Studio等工具快速构建训练数据
模式引导框架中，路径匹配算法能有效对齐嵌套属性，实现自动评估
持续预训练大型语言模型时，需精心筛选语料以避免低资源语言中的噪音数据，提高模型鲁棒性

papers.title: PaDoc: Layout-Grounded Parallel Decoding for Document Parsing
papers.summary: End-to-end document parsers provide a unified interface, but serialize page layouts and regional contents into one autoregressive sequence. This formulation forces independent regions onto a decoding path whose length grows with the total content, whereas crop-based two-stage parsers expose region-level parallelism at the cost of repeated visual prefills and fragmented page context. To retain full-page context while removing dependencies, we propose PaDoc, a layout-grounded parser that treats the predicted layout as a branching structure over a shared page representation. Under a region-sufficiency assumption, we derive a prefix-conditioned factorization in which the layout stream and regional content branches advance concurrently, reducing the decoding depth to the longest layout-content path. We realize this factorization within a single MLLM: packed variable-length ancestor attention preserves the visibility under standard next-token training, while masked parallel decoding creates branches that the evaluated vLLM backend serves as concurrent requests with cache-resident shared-prefix reuse. On OmniDocBench Full, PaDoc attains an Overall layout F1 of 91.1 and, among end-to-end parsers, a top-tier Overall score of 94.24 together with the best Text Edit (0.038) and Formula CDM (95.59). On a 384-page subset and one A800 GPU, it is the fastest end-to-end parser at five concurrency levels, improving valid-page throughput by 67.4-118% and reducing P95 latency by 39.2-54.9% relative to a same-backbone Sequential SFT baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Longin-Yu/Padoc
papers.zh_summary: PaDoc提出了一种基于布局的并行解码方法，用于端到端文档解析。它将页面布局视为共享页面表示上的分支结构，并推导出前缀条件因子分解，使布局流和区域内容分支并发推进，从而减少解码深度。该方法通过打包的变长祖先注意力保持可见性，并使用掩码并行解码创建分支，由vLLM后端作为并发请求处理，并复用共享前缀缓存。在OmniDocBench Full上，PaDoc的总体布局F1为91.1，端到端解析器中总体得分94.24，文本编辑距离0.038，公式CDM 95.59。在384页子集和一块A800 GPU上，五种并发级别下均是最快的端到端解析器，有效页面吞吐量提升67.4%-118%，P95延迟降低39.2%-54.9%（相比同骨干顺序SFT基线）。
papers.novelty: 提出布局作为分支结构的新颖解析范式，将页面布局与区域内容解耦为并行分支，有效解决端到端解析的序列长度依赖问题，同时保留全页上下文。
innovation_points: 提出布局作为分支结构的解析框架，将布局流与区域内容分支解耦，实现并行解码，减少解码深度。
推导前缀条件因子分解，并采用打包的变长祖先注意力实现标准next-token训练下的可见性。
利用掩码并行解码和vLLM后端的并发请求处理，实现缓存共享前缀复用，提升推理效率。
papers.limitations: 区域充分性假设可能不适用于区域间高度依赖的文档；实验仅评估了单一骨干网络和有限页面子集，需验证在更多场景和更大规模数据上的泛化性。
improvement_directions: 探索放松区域充分性假设以处理更复杂的文档布局。
扩展到更多骨干网络和多语言文档，评估泛化性。
进一步优化并行解码的调度策略以最大化硬件利用率。
papers.engineering_value: 为端到端文档解析提供了高效推理方案，显著降低延迟并提升吞吐量，可直接应用于生产环境中的扫描文档处理、表格识别等场景。
papers.why_relevant: 针对文档解析中的效率瓶颈提出创新解码框架，对OCR领域具有直接参考价值，尤其适用于大规模文档数字化需求。

papers.title: DTRNet: Dual Text-Radical Decoding for Handwritten Chinese Text Recognition with Faked Character Detection
papers.summary: In K-12 educational scenarios, handwritten Chinese text recognition should not only transcribe student writing, but also detect faked characters. However, existing recognition models are usually confined to a predefined set of normal characters and therefore cannot explicitly identify faked characters. Existing detection methods exhibit complementary limitations: character-level methods provide interpretable structural evidence but suffer from low efficiency, whereas line-level methods are efficient but rely heavily on confidence scores, making them prone to missed detections and lacking explicit structural evidence. Thus, the key challenge is to preserve character-structural evidence independent of contextual inference while maintaining line-level efficiency. To this end, we propose DTRNet, a dual Text-Radical decoding framework for line-level faked character detection. DTRNet decouples context-aware text recognition from character-wise structural verification, where the text branch performs line-level transcription and the radical branch predicts legal Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS) for lexicon-based faked character judgment. We further introduce IDS-Guided Confidence Adjustment (IGCA) to refine text predictions using structural evidence during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that DTRNet effectively detects faked characters while maintaining strong recognition performance and providing interpretable radical-level evidence. Code, checkpoints, and the processed dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/BNU-ERC-ITEA/DTRNet.
papers.zh_summary: DTRNet提出了一种双文本-字根解码框架，用于行级手写中文文本识别和伪造字符检测。该框架将上下文感知的文本识别与字符级结构验证解耦，文本分支负责行级转录，字根分支预测合法的表意文字描述序列（IDS）以进行基于词典的伪造字符判断。同时引入IDS引导的置信度调整（IGCA）在推理时利用结构证据细化文本预测。实验证明DTRNet能有效检测伪造字符，同时保持较强的识别性能并提供可解释的字根级证据。
papers.novelty: 首次将伪造字符检测融入行级识别框架，利用字根级结构证据实现可解释检测，克服了字符级方法效率低和行级方法依赖置信度的问题。
innovation_points: 提出双解码框架，将文本识别与字根结构验证解耦，实现行级效率与字符级结构证据并存。
引入IDS序列预测用于伪造字符的基于词典的判断，提供显式结构依据。
设计IGCA机制，在推理时利用结构证据调整文本预测置信度，提升整体性能。
papers.limitations: 依赖预定义字形结构词典，可能无法覆盖所有变体或艺术字；实验仅在特定教育场景评估，需验证更广泛的手写变体。
improvement_directions: 扩展IDS词典以涵盖更多变体字形。
探索在传统手写体或艺术字上的泛化能力。
将框架推广到其他需要结构验证的字符识别任务。
papers.engineering_value: 为教育场景提供自动化手写批改能力，可集成到OCR系统中检测伪造或不合规字符，提升识别可靠性。
papers.why_relevant: 关注手写识别中错误检测和可解释性，为OCR系统提供新的功能维度，具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI
papers.summary: We present a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text documents using generative AI, followed by automated semantic evaluation of the extracted information against a gold standard. The schema, serving as an information model encoding domain knowledge, provides a unified, systematic, and consistent framework for extraction of hierarchical, nested information, with attributes of variable cardinality, and subsequent evaluation of the results. Information extraction from a document is performed in a single call to the model, in zero-shot mode. In the evaluation step, we introduce a path-based semantic matching algorithm to align the nested, variable-cardinality attributes in the extracted results with those in the gold standard. We use generative AI for semantic comparison of the extracted and gold standard values of an attribute, and introduce a rubric to classify the result of the comparison, according to domain-specific considerations, as an exact, semantic, useful, or non-match. We were able to extract 12 out of 14 attributes with an F1 score of $>$90\% from documents published by the health technology assessment organisation NICE, using the generative AI model Claude Opus 3. The time needed to extract the attributes from a document was $\sim$30 times lower than the time taken by a human domain expert. We further demonstrate generalisability of this framework across different generative AI models and transferability across different HTA organisations and languages.
papers.zh_summary: 提出一个基于模式的框架，利用生成式AI从非结构化文本中提取复杂结构化信息，并自动评估提取结果与黄金标准的语义相似度。该模式编码领域知识，支持层次嵌套、可变基数的属性提取，并在零样本模式下单次调用模型完成提取。评估步骤引入基于路径的语义匹配算法对齐嵌套属性，并使用生成式AI进行语义比较，按领域特定考量分类为精确、语义、有用或不匹配。在NICE健康技术评估文档上，12/14个属性的F1分数超过90%，提取时间约为人类专家所需时间的1/30，且框架在多个模型、组织和语言上具有泛化性。
papers.novelty: 提出统一的模式引导框架，将提取和评估均基于模式进行，并引入路径匹配与生成式语义比较，系统化处理层次嵌套可变基数属性。
innovation_points: 基于模式的信息模型统一了提取和评估过程，支持层次嵌套属性。
提出路径匹配算法对齐嵌套可变基数属性。
利用生成式AI进行语义比较并定义分类规则，提升评估的灵活性。
papers.limitations: 依赖高质量的领域模式定义；零样本提取可能对复杂或含糊文本产生错误；评估的稳定性可能受生成模型影响。
improvement_directions: 研究自动模式构建或半自动模式完善方法。
探索多轮提取策略以提高准确性。
评估模型不确定性对评估结果的影响并建立置信度机制。
papers.engineering_value: 为文档理解提供自动化结构化抽取与评估方案，显著降低人工成本，适用于医疗、法律等领域的技术文档处理。
papers.why_relevant: 展示了生成式AI在信息抽取中的潜力，为OCR后的语义层处理提供新范式。

papers.title: Mapping Armenian Paris: Extracting and Geocoding Commercial Advertisements from the 20th-Century Diaspora Press
papers.summary: This paper presents an end-to-end, IIIF-based pipeline that turns the digitised Armenian press of France into an interactive map of the 20th-century Parisian Armenian commercial community. On each page, commercial advertisements are located, read, and parsed into structured records, which are then geocoded and placed on the map. Western Armenian is under-resourced and unsupported by off-the-shelf layout and OCR models, so the pipeline uses vision-language models (VLMs) as a data-bootstrapping strategy: they produce usable structured records at a scale hand annotation could not reach, and stay reliable on the strongly curved scans where conventional line-level CRNN OCR breaks down. The contribution includes a 500-page Western Armenian press corpus with 3,270 advertisement-level annotations, a Label Studio template that captures detection and semantic fields in a single annotation pass, and a reproducible workflow transposable to other under-resourced historical corpora. More broadly, the work shows that VLM-driven data bootstrapping is an effective lever for under-resourced historical languages such as (Western) Armenian.
papers.zh_summary: 本文提出了一个基于IIIF的端到端流水线，将数字化亚美尼亚法语报刊转化为20世纪巴黎亚美尼亚商业社区交互式地图。该流水线在每一页上定位、读取和解析商业广告为结构化记录，然后进行地理编码并在地图上展示。由于西亚美尼亚语资源匮乏且现成布局和OCR模型不支持，该流水线使用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为数据引导策略，生成可用结构化记录，并处理强烈弯曲的扫描。贡献包括500页西亚美尼亚语新闻语料库（含3270条广告级标注）、一个Label Studio模板以及可复现的工作流程。
papers.novelty: 首次为西亚美尼亚历史报纸构建自动化处理流水线，利用VLM引导数据生成，克服低资源语言OCR难题，支持弯曲扫描。
innovation_points: 端到端IIIF流水线：定位、读取、解析广告并地理编码，生成交互式地图。
利用VLM作为数据引导策略，实现低资源语言（西亚美尼亚语）的OCR和结构化提取。
提供500页标注语料和Label Studio模板，支持单轮标注检测与语义字段。
papers.limitations: VLM可能产生错误结构化记录；弯曲扫描仍有一定失败率；依赖IIIF兼容的数字化基础设施。
improvement_directions: 结合传统CRNN或自监督预训练提升VLM对低资源语言的适应性。
引入人类反馈循环优化标注模板和VLM提示。
将流水线扩展到其他历史性低资源语言。
papers.engineering_value: 为历史文献数字化提供可复现的完整流水线，尤其适用于低资源语言和弯曲扫描场景。
papers.why_relevant: 展示VLM在低资源OCR中的应用，提供数据引导策略，对OCR研究有启发意义。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Neighborhood Learning for Source-Free Cross-Scene Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.summary: Domain adaptation has advanced cross-scene hyperspectral image classification, significantly improving discriminative capability in complex scenarios. However, privacy rules or storage limits often block access to data from the source domain. Conventional domain adaptation methods become impractical, severely restricting their utility in realistic remote sensing scenarios. To tackle this challenge, we propose a topology-aware source-free learning framework. We first introduce the entropy momentum pseudo-labeling (EMP) to refine k-means assignments by leveraging entropy-aware confidence and temporal prediction momentum. Under the guidance of the refined pseudo-labels, we further utilize the contextual neighborhood topology (CNT) to exploit the intrinsic geometric structure of the target feature space. Combining the global structural information extracted by collaborative representation with the local similarity information modeled by nearest neighbor search, the CNT accomplishes the comprehensive encoding of manifold-level geometric properties in the target domain feature space. The overall objective integrates cross-entropy on refined pseudo-labels, log inner product-based topology consistency, and an information-maximization term for balanced classification, ensuring stable adaptation in the source-free setting. Extensive experiments on three typical cross-scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method exceeds state-of-the-art performance, and ablation studies further validate the contribution of each module. The results highlight the critical role of topology-aware modeling in achieving robust and accurate classification without source data.
papers.zh_summary: 提出一种拓扑感知的无源域跨场景高光谱图像分类框架。首先引入熵动量伪标签（EMP）改进k-means分配，利用熵感知置信度和时间预测动量。在细化伪标签指导下，利用上下文邻域拓扑（CNT）挖掘目标特征空间的几何结构，结合协作表示提取的全局结构信息和最近邻搜索的局部相似性，实现流形级几何特性的全面编码。总目标包括细化伪标签的交叉熵、基于对数内积的拓扑一致性以及信息最大化项，确保无源域设置下的稳定适应。在三个典型跨场景上超过现有最先进性能。
papers.novelty: 针对源域数据不可用的跨场景高光谱分类，首次引入拓扑感知学习，实现全局与局部几何信息的融合，有效适应无源域场景。
innovation_points: 提出熵动量伪标签（EMP）方法细化聚类分配，提高伪标签质量。
设计上下文邻域拓扑（CNT）编码流形级几何属性。
结合信息最大化项和拓扑一致性约束，实现紧凑且平衡的特征分布。
papers.limitations: 依赖目标域内固有的拓扑结构，在拓扑不明显或噪声大的场景中效果可能受限；实验仅限高光谱图像，可能需要调整以适应其他模态。
improvement_directions: 探索自适应选择拓扑尺度或邻域大小。
将方法扩展到其他跨场景视觉任务。
研究存在部分源域数据时的半监督变体。
papers.engineering_value: 在隐私敏感或数据存储受限场景下提供有效的跨场景分类方案，可应用于遥感图像分析。
papers.why_relevant: 拓扑感知的无源域适应方法对OCR中的跨域鲁棒性有借鉴意义，可启发文档图像域适应研究。

papers.title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
papers.summary: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling. Existing multilingual corpora and benchmarks are often poor proxies for the language, containing substantial amounts of noisy, machine-translated, and misclassified text. We address these gaps by introducing Oytser, a high-quality Yiddish pretraining corpus that combines contemporary web-native sources with literary materials, and Kashes, a multi-task benchmark spanning translation, linguistic analysis, information extraction, and language understanding. Using these resources, we continue pretraining Llama 3.1 8B to obtain MameLoshnLM. Across the tasks in the benchmark, MameLoshnLM outperforms open baselines of similar scale. Our analyses show that these gains are not only quantitative: relative to general-purpose multilingual models, MameLoshnLM better captures language-defining lexical and morphological patterns, pointing to a broader failure mode of noisy web-scale multilingual data for low-resource languages. Our results provide both a foundation for Yiddish NLP and a practical template for language model development in historically rich but digitally underrepresented languages.
papers.zh_summary: MameLoshnLM是首个开源8B参数规模的意第绪语语言模型。作者构建了高质量预训练语料库Oytser（结合当代网络来源和文学材料）以及多任务基准Kashes（涵盖翻译、语言分析、信息抽取和语言理解），基于Llama 3.1 8B进行持续预训练。在基准任务上，MameLoshnLM优于同等规模的开源基线模型，并显著捕捉到语言定义级的词汇和形态特征，表明通用多语言模型在低资源语言上存在噪音数据导致的失效模式。
papers.novelty: 首个为意第绪语专门构建的8B开源语言模型，并提供高质量语料和评估基准，为低资源语言模型开发提供范例。
innovation_points: 构建高质量意第绪语预训练语料Oytser，筛选并整合网络与文学资源。
创建多任务基准Kashes，涵盖翻译、语言分析、信息抽取等。
基于Llama 3.1进行持续预训练，适配低资源语言。
papers.limitations: 仅针对意第绪语，跨语言泛化性未验证；模型规模有限，可能受限于底层架构。
improvement_directions: 扩展到其他低资源语言，验证框架的可迁移性。
探索更大规模模型或更先进架构以提升性能。
增大基准任务覆盖面，增加更多语言理解维度。
papers.engineering_value: 为低资源语言提供可复现的语言模型开发流程，可借鉴于其他历史语言数字化和自动化处理。
papers.why_relevant: OCR文档中常含低资源语言，此工作提供语言模型支持，可增强OCR后处理的语言理解能力。
